_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v11: v10 plus the brand delta a rebuild from a clean 2.51.1 checkout had silently dropped. v9 was rebuilt from stock sources with only the recovered order-details delta applied, so four brand-level customizations that lived outside the .vue/.ts source maps went missing: the Barlow link in index.html, fontFamily.lato in tailwind.config.ts, the :root override block in assets/styles/_custom.scss (pill buttons, light header-top band, light footer, orange/blue links), and desktop_menu_mode: fullscreen in config/settings_data.json -- that last one is why the header showed the stock horizontal category strip instead of the CATALOG mega-menu button. All four were recovered verbatim from the v8 bundle. Verified before shipping: v11's compiled CSS is a strict superset of v8's (the only extra rules are the order-details widgets') and its compiled theme settings are byte-identical to v8's.
